question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a teal ball, Bob has a pink ball, and Claire has a grey ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Alice swap balls. Then, Bob and Alice swap balls. Finally, Claire and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) teal ball
(B) pink ball
(C) grey ball
solution:
Ball colors in Alice, Bob, Claire order:
Initial: teal, pink, grey
After Bob–Alice: pink, teal, grey
After Bob–Alice again: teal, pink, grey
After Claire–Alice: grey, pink, teal
Alice has the grey ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
